data.name: Ariba
data.gender_notes: Ariba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ariba is an Arabic name that signifies a strong connection with Allah. It is a name that symbolizes devotion and dedication to the Almighty. The name Ariba carries the meaning “Worshipper of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ariba usually hope their child will grow to embody worshipper of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Ariba is associated with the concept of Ibadah, or worship, emphasizing the importance of devoting oneself to Allah.
data.etymology: Ariba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Worshipper of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ariba total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Ariba is a unique Arabic name that is not commonly used in Western cultures. The name has historical roots in the Islamic tradition and Religion. It is often given to children as a sign of respect and attachment to Allah. The name is also a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's famous hadith that encourages Muslims to say "Labbaik allahuma labbaik, Labbaik, la shareeka laka labbaik, Innal hamda wa n'imata laka wal mulk, la shareeka lakasubhanata laka," which translates to "Here I am, Allah, here I am. You have no partner, and I am Your servant, here I am. Verily, all praises, blessings, and sovereignty are Yours, and You have no partner."
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ariba is an beautiful reminder of the spiritual connection between Allah and every Muslim. The name conveys a sense of devotion, commitment, and submission to Allah. It encourages the bearer of the name to strive for righteousness, seek the pleasure of Allah, and lead a life that is pleasing to Him. The name is a constant reminder of the greatness and majesty of Allah and serves as an inspiration to live a life that reflects His mercy, compassion, and love.
